description:
This project will construct a campus security fence surrounding the Vancouver VA Medical Center campus.
Contractor shall completely prepare site for building operations, including demolition and removal of existing
structures, furnish labor and materials, and perform work for 648-20-121 Construct Campus Security Fence and
Access Control (Vancouver) as required by drawings and specifications.
For all requirements, see the specifications, drawings, and contract documents.

***Notice Read Below

Certain attachments associated with this solicitation contain Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) information.

  • By requesting or accessing these documents, interested parties acknowledge that they will:
  • Use the information solely for the purpose of responding to this solicitation
  • Safeguard the information from unauthorized disclosure
  • Not distribute, release, reproduce, or disclose information outside their organization without prior written approval from the Government
  • Ensure any internal personnel accessing the information understand these restrictions
  • Vendors requesting access to the controlled documents must acknowledge acceptance of these conditions in their request.
  • (Enter this acceptance into the Reason for Access and email).

Contractors are required to request access through SAM.gov, then email Colleen.nicholson@va.gov and hector.sierraalmedina@va.gov that such request has been submitted. Email also needs to include the above acceptance.
